query: select observed_day, release_sha, device, metric, navigation, bucket, sample_count from public.app_web_vitals_histogram where observed_day >= date '2026-10-01' order by observed_day, release_sha, device, metric, bucket limit 160;
decoder: decode content JSON/result wrapper, then balanced JSON array; accept only objects containing all fixed columns and validate day/SHA/device/metric/bucket/count types
